conflicts: Ionization limit: NIST ASD lists an estimated [47500 +- 1000] cm^-1; the actinide laser-spectroscopy review of Block, Laatiaoui, Raeder (2021) quotes 49100(100) cm^-1 (from Wendt et al. 2014). The original measurement paper was not opened.

Selected-wavelength table versus level tables: for 486.149 nm the table prints the even level as '925' (level table: 825.415), for 637.925 nm the odd level as '15 611' (level table: 15671.520, J=13/2); the level-table values, which reproduce the observed wavenumbers, are used.
not_found: radiative lifetimes, transition probabilities, oscillator strengths or branching fractions of any Pa I level/line: none located (searched Crossref, arXiv, OSTI, the Laboratoire Aime Cotton database); only coarse emission intensities (3000 / 10000) are available
hyperfine A and B constants of 231Pa I levels: the Laboratoire Aime Cotton table gives only total hyperfine widths W (quoted in the level notes); no A/B values located

Naubereit, Gottwald, Studer, Wendt, Phys. Rev. A 98, 022505 (2018) (more than 1500 new high-lying levels by resonance ionization, first excitation steps used in Mainz) and Naubereit et al., Phys. Rev. A 98, 022506 (2018): only the abstracts could be opened (paywalled); the excitation schemes and the ionization potential derived there are not entered

two Pa I lines of the selected-wavelength table could not be matched to a level pair and are left out: 440.77 nm (printed 22716 J=11/2 - 0 J=11/2, wavenumber does not fit) and 696.009 nm (no level energies printed)
isotope shifts: no second long-lived isotope was studied optically (nothing located)
notes: All Pa I levels and line classifications come from the archived online version (2002/2003 captures) of the Blaise & Wyart actinide tables (Laboratoire Aime Cotton); energies refer to 231Pa (hyperfine centre of gravity). NIST ASD lists only the ground level 5f2.6d.7s2 4K11/2 and an estimated limit. Configurations are stored without the parent terms (the full printed string is in each level note). The classification in the wavelength table uses truncated level energies; each line was matched to the level tables with J and with the observed wavenumber (air wavelength converted with the Edlen formula; the residual is in each line note). 'relative_intensity' is the coarse photographic/emission intensity printed there (3000 or 10000) and only ranks lines. Lines with upper levels slightly above 30000 cm^-1 (30658.23 and 32234.42 cm^-1) are kept because they belong to the selected strong lines.
